# robots.txt for kinetic.curiosta.com. Generated by generators/seo.py (agents.py); do not edit by hand.
# AI training crawlers are blocked. Search engines and AI search or user-requested fetchers
# (Googlebot, Bingbot, Applebot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Amzn-SearchBot, Amzn-User, Meta-WebIndexer, MistralAI-Index and MistralAI-User) are allowed by the final "User-agent: *" group.
# Every blocked token is copied from its operator's own documentation (checked 23 Oct 2026).
# Google-Extended (also controls Gemini grounding) and Bytespider (documented as a search crawler) are not blocked.
# Amazonbot is deliberately allowed by Manoj's choice (23 Oct 2026). Amazon's page says
#   Amazonbot improves Amazon products and services and may be used to train Amazon AI models; it documents Alexa
#   search and answers for Amzn-SearchBot and Amzn-User. https://developer.amazon.com/amazonbot
#
# GPTBot (OpenAI): content that may be used to train generative AI foundation models.
#   https://platform.openai.com/docs/bots
# ClaudeBot (Anthropic): content that may contribute to model training.
#   https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8896518-does-anthropic-crawl-data-from-the-web-and-how-can-site-owners-block-the-crawler
# Applebot-Extended (Apple): control token: use of content to train Apple's foundation models; Applebot (search) is unaffected.
#   https://support.apple.com/en-us/119829
# Meta-ExternalAgent (Meta): training AI models or improving products by indexing content directly.
#   https://developers.facebook.com/docs/sharing/webmasters/web-crawlers/
# MistralAI-Training (Mistral AI): builds datasets for training Mistral generative AI models.
#   https://docs.mistral.ai/robots
# CCBot (Common Crawl): open web dataset widely used to train AI models; Common Crawl documents the Disallow rule.
#   https://commoncrawl.org/ccbot

# ---- AI training: blocked ----

Disallow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Applebot-Extended
Disallow: /

User-agent: Meta-ExternalAgent
Disallow: /

User-agent: MistralAI-Training
Disallow: /

User-agent: CCBot
Disallow: /

# ---- everyone else, including search engines and AI search / user fetchers ----
